messages:
Sree Patel: Quick sync — marketplace launch targeted 2026-05-10. We need a driver/CUDA/ROCm pin roadmap for partners and a short compatibility blurb. CC @ana @mike
Ana Gomez: Timeline acknowledged. We should lock minor versions for marketplace images. Partners want deterministic kernels.
Mike Chen: +1. We're seeing a perf regression on NVIDIA driver 525.60 with CUDA 12.3 for some transformer kernels. Recommend pinning to CUDA 12.2.x until the patch lands. :thinking_face:
Paul Rivera: Can we run a targeted regression matrix? I'll spin up jobs. Proposed matrix:
```yaml
cuda: [12.1, 12.2]
driver: [525.60, 526.30]
rocm: [5.4, 5.6]
models: [gptj-6b, llama-2-13b]
```
Paul Rivera: I'll schedule overnight runs and post results.
DevBot: Test job queued (#driver-compat-matrix-2026-04-01). ETA ~6h
Sree Patel: Good. For docs blurb, keep wording: "Verified: CUDA 12.2 + NVIDIA driver 526.30; ROCm 5.6 for AMD platforms." Short and clear.
Mike Chen: Also provide guidance for quantized builds — some partners use int8 builds that are sensitive to driver+cuda minor revs.
Ana Gomez: Legal/marketing asked for a disclaimer about non-exhaustive testing. Nina, can Legal review a 2-line disclaimer?
Nina Park: Yep. Send me the blurb, I'll approve or tweak.
Paul Rivera: One more ask: add an automatic fallback policy in marketplace metadata to pick the nearest compatible runtime if pinned one fails. I can PR a spec.
Sree Patel: That sounds good. Owners: Mike (driver regressions), Paul (matrix + fallback spec), Ana (partner comms), Nina (legal blurb). I'll assemble a one-page partner note by EOD tomorrow.
Mike Chen: FYI — if we need a hotfix, we'll coordinate with HW partner on staging drivers. Tag @hw-partner-bot when ready.
Hw-partner-bot: Acknowledged. Please share crash logs with drivers@hw-partner.com and mention ticket #PRM-334.
Ana Gomez: Thanks. I'll draft partner note and attach matrix results once Paul posts them. :thumbsup: 
Paul Rivera: Tests started. I'll update thread with artifacts and links.
Sree Patel: Great — let's reconvene after results. :eyes:
